==Description==
'''Victory's Kiss''' is an emote that could have been obtained from Major III of the [[PVP Season 0]]. It was made by Capra. The emote is looped and the player cannot move while performing this emote. It is not interactable and no music can be heard from it. Sounds can be heard while performing this emote.

When used, a golden trophy will fly towards the player, then will fly away.
